summary: Durable per-turn message CONTENT + structured pause/resume state for the structured assistant store (cinatra#1037 P5.6 drop-history, PR1 EXPAND). The drop-history ruling cuts /chat over to assistant_threads/assistant_turns with no backfill, but the structured store persists NO durable message content in Postgres (assistant_turns is metadata + a run_id pointer; text lives only in the bounded/lossy Redis AG-UI event log; the P2b mirror is deliberately content-less), so a direct read-cutover would degrade even NEW conversations. Fork-B (codex-converged) adds durable content FIRST; this is the EXPAND leg of the expand->cutover->contract stack, ADDITIVE ONLY (no read changes, no deletions, no cutover marker, no legacy-write fence — those are PR2/PR3). Two additive structural changes: (1) assistant_turns.content jsonb — the durable per-turn message content the legacy chat_threads.payload has held, capturing the FULL message object (role, content, parts, thinking, toolCalls, citations, attachments, mentions — whatever /chat needs for faithful reconstruction, not just terminal text); NULLABLE so pre-existing content-less shadow rows are undisturbed (by design — the PR3 DROP precondition checks content only on post-cutover-marker rows), with a CHECK (assistant_turns_content_object_check) keeping the column a JSON object when present; (2) assistant_thread_pause_state — structured pause/resume storage (one row per (thread_id, participant_id); presence == paused; resume deletes the row) with a FK to assistant_threads ON DELETE CASCADE and a per-thread read index, written ALONGSIDE the legacy payload.pausedParticipants which stays the authoritative read source until the PR2 cutover. ADDITIVE (a nullable column + a brand-new empty table + its FK/index; no row rejected, no data rewrite, no NOT NULL on existing data, no unique index on an existing table, no retype, no FK ON DELETE change to an existing key) — no artifact is REQUIRED; shipped anyway (core__0037/0047/0055/0057 precedent) to keep the fresh-bootstrap and operator-upgrade paths in lockstep with the idempotent buildCreateStoreSchemaQueries mirror (assistantThreadSchemaQueries in src/lib/assistant-thread-schema.ts). down() is a true reverse: drops the pause table + index, then the content column + its CHECK; the authoritative legacy chat_threads.payload is untouched so no user history is lost. SEQ IS PROVISIONAL: assigned at merge — shipped max on origin/main at build time is core__0060 (drop-dynamic-object-types); a concurrent lane may claim 0061 first, in which case renumber-at-merge is normal. migrations/** is HIGH-RISK: owner approval required; the lane never merges.
